title: Tiny GPT from Scratch
blurb: Build a small GPT piece by piece: byte-pair tokens, the next-token loss, causal and multi-head attention, a parameter budget and sampling, then run the whole model.
intro: A GPT is a stack of causal self-attention and MLP blocks trained to predict the next token. The steps build what you need to read and run one: a BPE merge, cross-entropy over a padded batch, masked attention, multi-head causal attention, an exact parameter count, and the temperature, top-k and top-p filters used for sampling. The capstone wires a one-layer model with fixed weights into a forward pass, a loss and a greedy decoding loop. Training the same model in PyTorch on a small text corpus is the natural next step.
